content: MCP Python SDK v2.0.0 (released 2026-07-28; primary docs/whats-new.md read + release notes cross-check): FastMCP renamed MCPServer (mcp.server.mcpserver.*; old path gone), protocol types split to mcp-types, transport config moved to run() (host/port/stateless_http/json_response/transport_security). Dual-era ZERO CONFIG: same streamable_http_app()/stdio answers 2025-era initialize+session AND 2026-07-28 stateless requests; stateless_http only affects 2025-era; 2026 path no Mcp-Session-Id (scale-out friendly). server/discover auto-derived; Client probes discover then falls back to initialize. cache_hints per method sets ttlMs/cacheScope; Client honors with built-in cache. Mcp-Method/Mcp-Name headers; x-mcp-header mirrored to Mcp-Param-*. Breaking: ping removed; ctx.elicit/create_message raise NoBackChannelError on 2026 (use InputRequiredResult/Resolve); tasks extension NOT implemented; ToolError text reaches model, MCPError becomes protocol error; sync handlers on worker thread; httpx2. GAPS: min Python version and outputSchema/structuredContent API not on whats-new page.
